description: Meteorological Drought Indices (SPI) and Vegetation Indices (NDVI) for the Kombolcha District, Ethiopia (2005–2024) is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. This dataset provides processed meteorological and biophysical remote sensing data for the Kombolcha district, Ethiopia, to support research on drought vulnerability and vegetation health. Contents: Meteorological Data: Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI) calculated at 3-month (seasonal) and 12-month (annual) timescales. Data were derived from CHIRPS v2.0 precipitation records (1981–2024) using the Climate Engine platform. Coverage: Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
